title: Revocation delta page (revocation-delta/1, DEC-0054)
description: A page of the revocation delta: consecutive signed entries of one estate's append-only chain and the head they lead to. A relay's delta frame carries it unchanged, and a check-in response's records.revocationDelta only from an organization server that has not adopted DEC-0128's UE-2 (FAC-SEM-149). The page's head is the carrier's hint; only a signed heartbeat's head binds. FAC-SEM-082 and the verifier applyDelta apply.

entries.description: Consecutive entries, oldest first: at most 256, so a relay frame stays under 1 MiB; a machine further behind asks again with delta-query.

head.description: A head of the revocation delta: the sequence of its last entry (0 before any) and the hex SHA-256 of that entry's RFC 8785 form without sig (the estate's genesis at 0), or a delta anchor's sequence and hash when no entry is held after it (deltaHead, DEC-0107). The shape of a device check-in's records.revocationDelta (DEC-0053) and an estate relay's welcome.deltaHead (DEC-0047).

alg.description: The estate key's algorithm, signed; EdDSA until Fabric records D2, when ES256 joins additively (DEC-0055 item 9). Anything else is unsupported-alg.

estate.description: The estate whose chain this is: the estate record's estate id.

sequence.description: 1 for the estate's first entry, then the previous entry's plus one: never skipped, never repeated.

prev.description: The head hash before this entry: the previous entry's hash, or for entry 1 the estate's genesis, SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of {type: "revocation-delta/1", estate, sequence: 0}.

at.description: When the hub issued the entry (RFC 3339 with an offset). A revision issued at or after it lists its revocation (FAC-SEM-084).

kid.description: The estate key: the kid of a machine's hubKey that the highest estate-record revision the verifier applied certifies (DEC-0055), not revoked there or by an entry applied before.

sig.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature (RFC 8032) over the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the document without sig, base64url without padding.

entry.description: One signed revocation. Its hash, the next head, is the hex SHA-256 of its RFC 8785 form without sig.

kind.description: The estate record's revocation kinds (DEC-0055 item 7) without authority: a passkey is revoked only by a revision a passkey signs.

ref.description: What is revoked, in its kind's own form, as the estate record's revocation names it.

revokedAt.description: When the revocation took effect; never after the entry's at.

revocation.description: A revocation in the estate record's own shape, so the next revision lists it as it came.
